finding: RunMirrorRecycleCase creates local MoEResidency off,on without Free. This type has no destructor that frees device/pinned resources or joins workers; normal and Q4T_CHECK early returns after successful Init leave workers retaining this pointers after object destruction. Earlier author static review missed this lifecycle issue.
required_fix: A local noncopyable RAII guard registered immediately after off/on construction; drain the shared model stream before Free on/off; guard destroyed before scratch buffers and before residency objects on every return. No runtime lifecycle changes.
existing_limit: MoEResidency::Free returns immediately if !inited_; preexisting partial-Init failure resource cleanup is outside this fixture fix. Guard must still invoke Free on both constructed objects; no claim of fixing arbitrary Init allocation failures.
verification: Independent protocol agent static review and root-owned later HTTP-first, build and numerical run. No execution performed as part of this finding.
wording_limit: Assertions cover GPU slot identities/recency and selected-route outputs, not bytewise comparison of all resident-slot payloads.
